note: Both sets mix correct Table 7-1 rows with trivial claims that bind table values to an invented "Baseline Blade-Pitch Controller" entity not named on the page. Set A reproduces the sensitivity values with correct E+6 exponents in nearly all rows and also captures Eq. 7-16a faithfully, whereas Set B drops the +6 exponent in four rows (-51.66E, -83.94E, -99.04E, -120.20E) and reports two sensitivities as -94.71 and -43.73 watt/rad under a wrong ∂P/∂β symbol. Set B does cover a few rows A omits (20.0, 24.0 m/s), but its value misreadings are more numerous and severe, while A's main flaws are one truncated -28.24E entry, one -43.73 ∂P/∂β entry, and several duplicate rows.
